notes:
The printed 34.1s is the post hoc between-partner-condition mean difference; no standardized effect or numerical p/bound is printed for that comparison. Statistical significance alone was not converted into a p bound. Replication title and DOI verified against publisher metadata, but accessible material was abstract-only. Publisher full-text route returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex supplied no OA full text; targeted repository/preprint searches and author Academia profile supplied no accessible full text. No replication values or narrative verdict were extracted from the abstract.
Source follow-up: Primary source is 2016 online-first copy, numbered pp. 1–15 plus publisher cover. Numerics verified on rendered PDF pp. 9–10. Analyses pool prior Wave 1 with newly collected Wave 2; no independent Wave-2-only statistic substituted. Canonical TXT renders partial eta squared as h2p in audit 1793; PDF confirms the metric.
Completion source review (n_r): Table 1 final groups and the explicit three-condition performance model document the summed model analytic N. N was not inferred from degrees of freedom. Hypothesis 2 uses the shared three-condition model; distinguish its full model N from the two nonzero-weight groups.
